Move around a picture that is bigger than its window. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **Drag to move around in the image and PDF viewers.** Once a picture or a page is zoomed in past the pane, holding the left button and dragging moves it, the way it already moved a diagram in the diagram window. A click on its own still does nothing but click, and a double-click still swaps between fitting the page and a closer look.

This is the first of a pass over the small interactions rather than the features: the wheel, clicks and drags, checked one by one against what VS Code does with the same gesture.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon) | `Malgel-0.1.7-macos-arm64.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.7-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.7-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.7-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.7-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed ad hoc and not notarized, so Gatekeeper blocks it after download: right-click it and choose Open once, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Malgel.app`. The Windows files are unsigned: SmartScreen may warn, and **More info → Run anyway** gets past it. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
